Police and criminal exchange fire in Karnal; suspect shot in leg

In Karnal, Haryana, a police team engaged in a shootout with a criminal who allegedly fired three rounds at officers. The suspect was subsequently shot in the leg during the exchange of fire. The individual was reportedly wanted in nine cases. The incident occurred in Karnal.
